harness.COMMANDS.md:
# Prepared P256 public validation

Run only after the integration owner grants a slot. Every phase checks the
frozen width-8 runtime SHA-256, matching SDK compiler, plugin build inputs and
private Ash sources, and writes tool/artifact/input hashes alongside the log.

From `/srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/prepared-crypto/sdk`, sequentially:

```sh
nix develop --command bash /srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/plugins/_build/prepared-crypto/p256/_build/prepared-public-validation/run.sh smoke
nix develop --command bash /srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/plugins/_build/prepared-crypto/p256/_build/prepared-public-validation/run.sh accept-fail
```

Review the six generated diagnostics, then:

```sh
nix develop --command bash /srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/plugins/_build/prepared-crypto/p256/_build/prepared-public-validation/run.sh verify-fail
nix develop --command bash /srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/plugins/_build/prepared-crypto/p256/_build/prepared-public-validation/run.sh ash
```

The runner uses one worker and the exact SDK/bin/moc wrapper, which resolves
SDK/src/moc and SDK/rts/mo-rts{,-debug}.wasm. Ash is copied locally, with only its
binary resolver changed to select that same wrapper. didc and PocketIC retain
the existing source Ash resolution and are hashed in each provenance record.
No global binary or home variable changes. The local ignored .mops symlink
selects the existing core@2.5.0 checkout without installing dependencies.

Ash runs the committed 18-method P256 suite with --force-gc and --sanity-checks.
The retained prepared-key test requires observed reclamation, including a
second collection after dropping every saved actor/continuation root.
harness.run.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
p256_root=/srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/plugins/_build/prepared-crypto/p256
p256_sdk=/srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/prepared-crypto/sdk
phase=${1:-}
case "$phase" in smoke|accept-fail|verify-fail|ash) ;; *) echo 'usage: run.sh {smoke|accept-fail|verify-fail|ash}' >&2; exit 2;; esac
mkdir -p "$p256_root/_build/prepared-public-validation/logs"
p256_timestamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)
p256_log="$p256_root/_build/prepared-public-validation/logs/$phase-$p256_timestamp.log"
export MOTOKO_ROOT="$p256_sdk"
export PATH="$p256_sdk/bin:$PATH"
cd "$p256_sdk"
run_phase() {
  python3 "$p256_root/_build/prepared-public-validation/preflight.py" "$p256_log.provenance.json" || return $?
  case "$phase" in
    smoke)
      test-runner -b -j 1 "$p256_root/packages/fast/tests/run/crypto-p256.mo"
      ;;
    accept-fail|verify-fail)
      p256_flags=()
      if [[ "$phase" == accept-fail ]]; then p256_flags=(-a); fi
      test-runner -b -j 1 "${p256_flags[@]}" "$p256_root"/packages/fast/tests/fail/crypto-p256-prepared-*.mo
      ;;
    ash)
      bun "$p256_root/_build/prepared-public-validation/ash-local/src/index.ts" test "$p256_root/packages/fast/tests/ash/P256.ash.json" --verbose
      ;;
  esac
}
run_phase 2>&1 | tee "$p256_log"
echo "Log: $p256_log"

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess, sys
root = Path('/srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/plugins/_build/prepared-crypto/p256')
sdk = Path('/srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/prepared-crypto/sdk')
hashfile = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
manifest = json.loads((root/'dist/p256/build.json').read_text())
assert manifest['sha256']['runtime.wasm'] == '0d2fa29baa9ab136ba5bd8a0cb55da5478ff6459fe1e8c02fecdc3e25dde3972', 'not frozen width-8 runtime'
moc = sdk/'src/_build/default/exes/moc.exe'
assert hashfile(moc) == manifest['moc_sha256'], 'plugin compiler does not match selected SDK'
for name, expected in manifest['sha256'].items():
    assert hashfile(root/'dist/p256'/name) == expected, f'artifact changed: {name}'
for name, expected in manifest['source_sha256'].items():
    assert hashfile(root/name) == expected, f'build input changed; rebuild first: {name}'
provenance = json.loads((root/'_build/prepared-public-validation/ash-source-provenance.json').read_text())
for name, hashes in provenance['files'].items():
    assert hashfile(root/'_build/prepared-public-validation/ash-local'/name) == hashes['copied_sha256'], f'copied Ash input changed: {name}'
paths = {
 'sdk_moc': moc,
 'sdk_moc_wrapper': sdk/'bin/wrapper.sh',
 'sdk_rts': sdk/'rts/mo-rts.wasm',
 'sdk_debug_rts': sdk/'rts/mo-rts-debug.wasm',
 'didc': Path('/home/devbox/.local/bin/didc'),
 'pocketic': Path('/home/devbox/.local/bin/pocket-ic'),
 'bun': Path(shutil.which('bun')),
}
runner = shutil.which('test-runner')
if runner: paths['test_runner'] = Path(runner)
record = {
 'sdk_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(sdk),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
 'moc_version': subprocess.check_output([str(sdk/'bin/moc'),'--version'],text=True).strip(),
 'plugin_build_manifest_sha256': hashfile(root/'dist/p256/build.json'),
 'plugin_artifacts': manifest['sha256'],
 'test_inputs': {str(p.relative_to(root)):hashfile(p) for p in sorted((root/'packages/fast/tests').rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and ((p.name in ('P256.mo','P256.ash.json','crypto-p256.mo')) or p.name.startswith('crypto-p256-prepared-'))},
 'public_module_sha256': hashfile(root/'packages/fast/src/P256.mo'),
 'core_inputs': {str(p.relative_to(root/'packages/fast/.mops/core@2.5.0/src')):hashfile(p) for p in sorted((root/'packages/fast/.mops/core@2.5.0/src').rglob('*.mo'))},
 'tools': {name:{'path':str(path.resolve()),'sha256':hashfile(path.resolve())} for name,path in paths.items()},
}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('P256 plugin, SDK, build-input closure and private Ash source hashes verified.')
harness.prepare-harness.py:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess
root = Path('/srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/plugins/_build/prepared-crypto/p256')
ash = Path('/srv/shared/code/ash')
out = root / '_build/prepared-public-validation/ash-local'
if out.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f'refusing to overwrite existing harness: {out}')
out.mkdir(parents=True)
shutil.copytree(ash / 'src', out / 'src')
for name in ('package.json', 'ash.schema.json', 'bun.lock', 'LICENSE'):
    if (ash / name).is_file(): shutil.copy2(ash / name, out / name)
(out / 'node_modules').symlink_to(ash / 'node_modules', target_is_directory=True)
resolver = out / 'src/binaries.ts'
source = resolver.read_text()
needle = '  const { binDir } = getGlobalCachePaths();'
assert source.count(needle) == 1
private = '/srv/shared/code/motoko_experiments/prepared-crypto/sdk/bin/moc'
source = source.replace(needle, '  // Isolated prepared-P256 test harness: all other binaries retain Ash resolution.\n  if (binaryName === \'moc\') return ' + json.dumps(private) + ';\n' + needle)
resolver.write_text(source)
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
files = {}
for p in sorted(out.rglob('*')):
    if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink():
        rel = str(p.relative_to(out))
        files[rel] = {'original_sha256': sha(ash / rel), 'copied_sha256': sha(p)}
assert [p for p,v in files.items() if v['original_sha256'] != v['copied_sha256']] == ['src/binaries.ts']
provenance = {
 'ash_source': str(ash),
 'ash_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ash),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
 'ash_status_at_copy': subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ash),'status','--short'],text=True),
 'sdk_moc_override': private,
 'node_modules': str((out/'node_modules').resolve()),
 'change': 'Only the copied binaries.ts resolver selects private SDK moc. didc, PocketIC and global toolchain files are unchanged.',
 'files': files,
}
(root/'_build/prepared-public-validation/ash-source-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\n')
print(f'Prepared isolated Ash source with {len(files)} hashed files; exactly one resolver change. No tests executed.')
